# `/task-status` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /task-status/v1/{id}

`getTaskStatusV1` — Get task status by id

Get task status by task ID. Types of tasks include account and entitlement aggregation and other general background processing tasks. Data for tasks older than 90 days will not be returned.

- Scopes: idn:task-management:read, idn:task-management:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Task ID.
- Returns 200: taskstatus

### PATCH /task-status/v1/{id}

`updateTaskStatusV1` — Update task status by id

Update a current task status by task ID. Use this API to clear a pending task by updating the completionStatus and completed attributes.

- Scopes: idn:task-management:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Task ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: taskstatus

### GET /task-status/v1

`getTaskStatusListV1` — Retrieve task status list

Use this endpoint to get a list of statuses for **all** tasks, including completed, in-progress, terminated, and errored tasks. Types of tasks include account and entitlement aggregation and other general background processing tasks. Data for tasks older than 90 days will not be returned. For a list of **in-progress** tasks, apply the isnull filter to the Completion Status field.

- Scopes: idn:task-management:read, idn:task-management:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; sourceId: eq, in; completionStatus: eq, in, isnull; type: eq, in; launcher: eq, in — e.g. `type eq "CLOUD_ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION" and completionStatus isnull`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created — e.g. `-created`
- Returns 200: array of taskstatus
